name: Busbar
summary: A common conductive connection distributing power to connected circuits.
description: A busbar connects multiple power circuits to a common electrical node. In an SLD it is commonly represented as a line with feeder connections. The representation describes connectivity; physical conductor dimensions, enclosure, phase arrangement and current-carrying capabilities are separate equipment information.

Bus sections and bus couplers describe how those electrical nodes can be connected or separated. Keep bus labels consistent between the system drawing, switchboard schedule and equipment documentation. A drawing line is not a scale representation of a physical busbar.
readingNotes: Identify each feeder connected to the same bus section.
Use device positions to determine which sections are shown as connected in the stated drawing condition.
drawingChecklist: Name each bus or bus section.
Cross-reference any coupler or section device.
distinction: A busbar is an electrical connection. Busbar trunking is a physical distribution system with model-specific enclosures and fittings.
